simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to כְּרֵתִי (H3774) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: a.
simple.whyItMatters: This word appears 10 times in the Hebrew Bible, so BibleIQ can compare how Scripture uses it across multiple passages.
simple.summary: כְּרֵתִי (Kᵉrêthîy) means a Kerethite or life-guardsman First listed occurrence: 1Chr 18 17.

definitions.full: H3774. Kerethi כְרֵתִי adjective, of a people , always with article, or plural, as substantive, Kerethites , a name for Philistines or a part of them (perhaps = Cretans , compare ᵐ5 Zeph 2:5 ; Ezek 25:15 ; on Crete as original home of Philistines, see מְּלִשְׁתִּי כַּפְתֹּר, ); — הַכְּרֵתִי = substantive collective; — הַכּ ׳נֶגֶב 1Sam 30:14 (compare Dr; ᵐ5 B Ξολθει , ᵐ5 L Ξορρι A Ξερηθει ); of soldiers of David's guard, ׳הַכּ וְהַמְּלֵתִי 2Sam 8:18 (read ׳עַלהַֿכּ Th We Dr and others) = 1Chr 18:17 ; 2Sam 15:18 ; 20:7 + 20:23 Qr ( > Kt הכרי ), 1Kin 1:38 , 44 ( ᵐ5 Ξελεθθει , Ξερεθθει , etc.); plural כְּרֵתִים Ezek 25:16 (|| מְּלִשְׁתִּים ; ᵐ5 . Κρῆτας ); כְּרֵתִים גּוֺי Zeph 2:5 ( ᵐ5 Κρητῶν ; || פלשׁתים ארץ ): in 2:6 We reads כֶּרֶת = Philistia (see [ כָרָה ], below I. כרה ). כִּשְׂבָּה כֶּשֶׂב, see כֶבֶשׂ etc.
definitions.rootNote: probably from 3772 in the sense of executioner; (compare 2876 ) (only collectively in the singular as plural)
